Welcome to the LARP subverse where all those that LARP are welcomed! Before we start please take note that this is my first time moderating so please bear with me.

Now then this is the place to introduce yourselves to the other Larpers here if you wish. If you do please include your persona, which games you play (cross play is accepted and encouraged) and how long you've been playing so you could better help others intrested in your game. I'll go first!

Im Ser Issam the Black Gryphon and I'm a stick jock in Dagorhir, I've been swinging stick for close to 10 years now and have tried 1 year of Amtgard and 2 months of SCA.
Welcome to the Tavern, come in and introduce yourself! (Introduction posts)

Heyo, Ser Issam! It's a pleasure to meet you.

My name's Kenny, and I've been involved with LARP on and off for about eight years. I used to be heavily involved with my university's LARPing society, but after graduation, I have predominantly been involved with small, one-off roleplays. I have organised a few modest events, but nothing of a grand or majestic scale.

I have a preference for hard skill based rulesets, but do not object to the occasional soft skill if it isn't too immersion breaking. Since I am a huge tabletop nerd, I enjoy writing rules and have earned something of a reputation for writing minimalistic, but robust rulesets.

My personas/characters vary depending on what game I am playing, but I love playing relatively simple and plain characters, such as sellswords or men at arms. At a murder myatery evening, I even roleplayed as a butler once, which was an enormously entertaining challenge.

So yeah, there's my intro. I guess the TL,DR of it is that I'm moderately experienced, but that experience is scattered across a wide variety of rulesets and character archetypes rather than being centred on just one.

Notlogic here. New LARPer from the southern US. Started going to Nexus in Mississippi last February... playing a ranger tree-folk named Julien. Nexus doesn't have rangers, though, so I'm struggling through it. IRL friends at this LARP are all that keeps me from moving to one closer to home with more players and an actual ranger class, but it's fun so I'm not mad bro.

I also do some leather crafting, which is a synergistic hobby.

I play Riflemen Jason Sweetwater, a Private Second Class in the UN Stargate Command with a loud mouth and tendency to fix all problems with explosives.

Our game is coming up to its 20th anniversary. Although I've only been involved for just over a year.

We're a military simulation role playing group that uses Airsoft guns for combat. However, getting shot is meaningful and often results in permanent character death. Dead PCs play as bad guys for the next three games. And as we only play once a quarter getting hurt is serious business.

We mostly do flight missions at night, gating out to new worlds to find our servicemen infected by an alien nanoplague and trying to map the vast Stargate network.
